newsitem.title: USA: PP&L gets 79 pct of preferred sought. [CORRECTED 17:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: PP&L gets 79 pct of preferred sought. [CORRECTED 17:15 GMT]

text.p: PP&L Resources Inc said Monday 79 percent of Pennsylvania Power & Light Co's 4-1/2 percent preferred stock and series preferred stock PP&L offered to purchase was tendered.

The company's offer to purchase any and all shares of the preferred stocks expired on Friday, which was the expiration date originally announced. The settlement date is expected to be Thursday, April 10, the company said.

Of the preferred traded on the New York Stock Exchange, the company said 271,027 shares of its class B (corrects from "class A") preferred -- the 4-1/2 percent preferred -- were tendered as were 110,558 shares of the class A (corrects from "class B") -- the 4.40 percent series preferred stock. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
